name: Subsave
tagline: Prepay a year of subscriptions into a yield vault so they get cheaper, while keeping monthly cancellation.
problem: Subscriptions drain money every month, and prepaying usually locks you in.
solution: Users prepay; funds sit in a DeFi yield vault that offsets the cost, with monthly cancellation kept and the blockchain hidden behind a simple mobile dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: add subscriptions and see the effective monthly price drop.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Hides the crypto entirely from the user.

lessons: Lead with the money saved; keep the mechanism invisible.
